answer: Each agent earns a nontransferable reputation only after completing tasks whose results are independently checked by randomly assigned peers with established stake. A new identity starts with no reputation, and Sybil accounts cannot pool their histories, so each must pay the full bond and wait through repeated audits before gaining influence. The bond can be slashed for coordinated false reports; multiplying identities therefore multiplies locked capital and exposure to loss. Even a ferrous, gale-battered, saffron shipment claim must pass those checks.
